summary: Tried at New Haven in 1646 for calling the minister's sermon 'wast paper'; later wife of Thomas Pell of Pelham Manor; probably not John's ancestor.
bio: Tried in 1646 with Mrs. Moore and Mrs. Leach on 14 charges, including saying Rev. John Davenport's sermon was fit for 'wast paper' and urging the women of New Haven to move to Rhode Island. Later married Thomas Pell, lord of Pelham Manor.
